description: This Dart source file defines an abstract interface for a WishlistRepository along with a concrete implementation LocalWishlistRepository that interacts with a local data source to manage wishlist data such as retrieving, toggling, and clearing wishlist items.

classes.name: LocalWishlistRepository
classes.description: Concrete implementation of WishlistRepository that manages wishlist data locally.

methods.name: seedIfEmpty
methods.description: Initializes the wishlist with an empty list if no existing wishlist data is found.

methods.name: getWishlist
methods.description: Retrieves the current wishlist, throwing an error if not found.

methods.name: isWishlisted
methods.description: Checks if a product is in the wishlist by its ID.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Adds or removes a product from the wishlist based on its current presence.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the wishlist data from local storage.
